question_summary: Foreman reports a conflicting utility line discovered beneath the slab area at Pour 3, differing from the assumed condition in General Conditions Article 3, and requests direction on whether to proceed with a proposed local layout shift or wait for design review.
proposed_solution: Shift the slab/utility layout locally at the conflict point and hold all other work per the original plan.
deadline_text: A response next week would still let us stay on track.
routing_rationale: The issue involves an underground utility conflict requiring civil engineering evaluation and coordination with structural slab design before field crews can proceed.
